contexts.text: Let them that are in Judea flee into the mountains ()... Judea = the Church, and indeed the Celestial Church; as is everywhere evident from the Word of the Old Testament, both historical and prophetical.
They who are in the first class, namely, they who are in love to the Lord, are signified in special by, Let them that are in Judea flee into the mountains.

That Judea, in the internal sense of the Word, does not signify Judea... may be evident from many passages in the Word. Judea is not so frequently mentioned in the Word as the land of Judah; and thereby, as by the Land of Canaan, is signified the Lord's Kingdom, consequently also the Church... and this because by Judah, or the Jewish nation, is represented the Lord's Celestial Kingdom. Illustrated.
By Judea () is meant the Church.
Let them that are in Judea flee upon the mountains = that those who are of the Lord's Church should remain in the good of love. By Judea is signified the Lord's Church.
That the tribe of Judah, and Judea = the Celestial Church. References.
